guide.lead: What you can do on each page. Press Open to go to it.
guide.item: Type an item name (Japanese, English or hiragana) to list the missions, enemies, bounties and relics that drop it, with chances. Choose which kinds to search (materials, parts/blueprints, mods, relics, others) with the checkboxes; your choice is saved on this PC (materials, parts/blueprints and mods at first). While parts/blueprints are selected, you can narrow the candidates by category (same as the Mastery list). Check "Exclude Prime" to hide parts that come from relics (Prime blueprints and parts); Prime items obtained elsewhere, such as from bounties, stay. Check "Exclude unobtainable" to hide parts that only come from vaulted relics (relics that drop nowhere in the current drop tables); such parts are marked "Vaulted". Relics that Varzia offers for Aya during the current Prime Resurgence count as obtainable and are marked "Prime Resurgence until …" (the period is fetched from the official World State on data update). Parts from clan research (with the lab), Simaris offerings and quest rewards are also listed. Items found in none of these (market, invasion rewards, etc.) are not listed.
guide.area: Pick a planet or node to see what it drops and the chances, stage by stage. Use the checkboxes to choose which kinds to show (resources, parts & blueprints, mods, relics, other).
guide.enemy: Type an enemy name to list the resources, blueprints, mods and other items it drops per kill, with chances. Choose which kinds to show with the checkboxes; your choice is saved on this PC (all kinds at first). You can also open an enemy here by clicking its name in the source tables of Find by Item and Mods. Boss rewards (such as Assassination missions) are mission rewards rather than enemy drops, so look them up in Find by Area or Find by Item.
guide.recipe: Enter the name of a Warframe, weapon, etc. (anything in the mastery list that is built from a blueprint) to see the materials needed to build it, nested by component. Components (Neuroptics, Chassis, Systems, Barrel, etc.) are opened to show their own materials; Forma, Orokin Cells, refined ores and weapons used as ingredients are shown as materials without opening them. Credits and build time for the blueprint and each component, where to get each material (top 2 by chance; the Conclave only when there is no other source), and the totals of materials and credits are shown too. Items with more than one recipe show all of them. The data comes from the official Public Export blueprints and is fetched with Data Update.
guide.mastery: Tick off mastered Warframes and weapons and check your progress per category. You can also read mastered items from the game's Extras equipment list (screen sharing or screenshots) and tick them.
guide.quests: Track completed quests and Junctions. Items whose prerequisites are not complete cannot be ticked, and you can see what is missing and the order to clear them (the route).
guide.mods: Look up where mods drop and tick the ones you own. Mod lists can also be read from a screenshot.
guide.arcane: Record the arcanes you own and their ranks.
guide.baro: See Baro's history list and this visit's items, checked against what you own.
guide.todo: Write your own daily, weekly and long-term tasks and check them off. Daily tasks reset at 00:00 UTC, weekly tasks on Monday 00:00 UTC, and long-term tasks never reset. The To-Do button at the top right lets you check daily and weekly tasks from any page.
guide.riven: See Riven prices per weapon from the official weekly stats.
guide.invasion: Shows the invasions in progress (location, rewards, progress) and every weapon part invasions give. Tick the parts you have collected.
guide.arbitration: Shows the current Arbitration and the schedule for the next 12 hours (node, mission type, enemy). The schedule is the one published by browse.wf.
guide.cycle: Day/night for the open worlds and the time until the daily and weekly resets. Also shows this week's Steel Essence exchange reward.
guide.duviri: This week's Duviri Circuit rewards and the coming rotation, for Normal and Steel Path.
guide.modstats: Find mods by the stat they change (Ability Strength, Multishot, ...) and compare their effects from rank 0 to max. Full-text search of the effect text is also available.
guide.primes: See the Prime Access releases you can get now as gauges of how long they have been out. Redder ones are likely to enter the Prime Vault sooner. The Prime Resurgence (Varzia) offerings and the release order of the frames are also shown.
guide.qa: Ask a question in a sentence (e.g. "Rhino のアーマーは?") to get frame/weapon stats, drop locations, the developer's builds and Helminth info from your local data. Answers are in Japanese only.
guide.build: Save and manage your builds. Mods and more can be read from a screenshot (uses Windows text recognition).
guide.sim: Calculate frame stats, weapon DPS and Riven ranges.
guide.tips: Shows your own notes (.md / .csv / .txt). Edit the files in the tips folder to change it.
guide.update: Fetch the official data (drop tables, Japanese names, Riven prices, etc.). Run it after game updates.
